problem: Hiring is slow; Prism sources, screens and delivers shortlists with AI agents.
business_model: Recruiting agency: $500 per month retainer while searching plus 15% of first-year base salary

founders.name: Theo Kitsberg
founders.background_notes: Ran recruiting and training for a mental health helpline; CHI '26 paper with MIT Media Lab and Cambridge.

technical_complexity.rationale: Sourcing, outreach and screening agents built on commercial LLMs plus human recruiters; standard engineering for a two-person team in 2025-26.

defensibility.rationale: Managed service whose AI tooling is copyable; any moat would come from placement track record and candidate data, none shown yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found in sources; too early to judge.

market_need_then: Hiring is slow and costly for startups; the company sells on a 15% of first-year salary success fee. No independent demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses the try- prefix domain tryprism.com (date not sourced).

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources reached; EveryDev listing dates the rename and the launch of new recruiting agents to 2026-04-10.

brand_strength.rationale: Only months old after a rebrand; the name collides with many unrelated Prism companies (an analytics firm, a Prism Digital, an AI video startup, PrismHR) per search results. No community or press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Prism is a Spring 2026 two-founder AI-native recruiting agency, formerly HireGlide, that rebranded in April 2026 and sells a managed service on a success fee. It is too early for an outcome: no priced round beyond a possible YC standard deal, no exit and no independent traction data were found, so nothing supports success or failure factors yet.
notes: Directory Active, consistent. Batch conflict: sources variously say F25, P26 and Spring 2026; the directory says Spring 2026. Location conflict: YC lists London in the dataset, another listing San Francisco. A $500,000 YC standard-deal seed dated 2025-09 appears only on everydev.ai (unverified, not recorded as a round). Competitors dated near the batch were not found in sources (NeuronFeed alternatives list is undated), so the list is empty. Benchmark claims (PSB 89.6) are self-reported. Pricing: $500 per month retainer while searching plus 15% of first-year base salary per tryprism.com (earlier record).
